key_insight: FlowLet synthesizes high-quality, age-conditional 3D brain MRIs by combining wavelet-domain representation with a flow-matching generative model, enabling efficient and faithful volume generation for downstream tasks.
problem_solved: Addresses the scarcity and demographic skew in 3D brain MRI datasets (which limit Brain Age Prediction fairness and generalization) by providing a method to generate realistic, age-balanced synthetic MRI volumes without new subject acquisition.
method: Decompose 3D MRI volumes into multi-scale wavelet coefficients so the model works in a compact, multi-resolution representation.
Train a conditional flow-matching generative model in the wavelet domain to learn the distribution of brain structure given age (and other covariates).
Reconstruct full-resolution 3D MRIs from predicted wavelet coefficients, enabling fast sampling with preserved anatomical detail.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical tool to augment and balance MRI datasets for tasks like Brain Age Prediction, improving model fairness and generalization while reducing reliance on costly or sensitive data collection.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: input age + covariates → wavelet decomposition → conditional flow-matching model → wavelet reconstruction → synthetic 3D MRI.
Side-by-side slices/volumetric renders comparing real vs. synthetic MRIs to show visual fidelity.
Age-conditional interpolation grid showing smooth anatomical changes across target ages.
Bar/histogram showing dataset demographic distribution before vs. after synthetic augmentation (e.g., age balance).
paper_title: FlowLet: Conditional 3D Brain MRI Synthesis using Wavelet Flow Matching
paper_authors: Danilo Danese, Angela Lombardi, Matteo Attimonelli, Giuseppe Fasano, Tommaso Di Noia
